description: Get every URL a website lists in its XML sitemaps: finds sitemaps via robots.txt and common paths, follows sitemap indexes (up to 5 children) and returns URLs with lastmod dates. Optional limit (default 1000, max 5000). Takes 1-6 s. Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.003 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.

name: sitemap
title: Get every URL a website lists in its XML sitemaps
